Hi Emma — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the expansion. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) PO routing: we can accept a single annual PO covering the base + expansion; please include a line-item for the committed token tiers and an escalation clause for overage billing. Preferred delivery: billing@redwoodinference.com (email) or upload to our customer portal (link in Doc below).

2) Required tax docs: for US entities we need a current W9 and the legal entity name + EIN on the PO. If you're EU-registered, we will need VAT/EORI details instead — let me know which applies.

3) Terms: standard is Net30. For larger committed renewals we can consider Net45 or Net60 with finance approval; Marissa will pull the proper approval if you'd like Net45.

4) Next steps I'd like to track:
   - Procurement sends PO (PO number + PDF) to billing@redwoodinference.com
   - Attach W9 (or VAT evidence) to the PO email
   - Marissa to confirm any concession / credit for the upsell

If you can send the PO by end of this week we can lock July 1 start and provision the increased capacity. I've attached a short PO checklist.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Partner Ops — Finance & Renewals
Redwood Inference
Attachments: PO_Checklist.pdf
